build_diffusion_unet_model: build a DiffusionUnet model with configurable depth, hidden channels, and growth for audio diffusion
create_resblock_module: create a ResBlock with 1D convolutions, group normalization, and residual skip connections
build_encoder_layer: build an EncoderLayer with strided 1D convolution and stacked residual blocks for downsampling
build_decoder_layer: build a DecoderLayer with transposed convolution and residual blocks for upsampling in the U-Net
run_diffusion_unet_forward: run the DiffusionUnet forward pass with input tensor, diffusion step, and optional condition tensor
